# Pablo Villoslada-Blanco, PhD

Pablo Villoslada-Blanco is a bioinformatician and biostatistician based in Madrid, Spain. He is a Postdoctoral Research Assistant affiliated with the Spanish National Cancer Research Center (CNIO) and CIBERONC.

## Core positioning

Bioinformatics & Biostatistics for AI-driven precision medicine. He helps biomedical teams transform complex omics, clinical and imaging data into interpretable models, reproducible analyses and translational insight.

## Primary areas of expertise

- Bioinformatics and biostatistics
- Artificial intelligence and machine learning for biomedical data
- Multi-omics integration
- Precision medicine
- Pancreatic cancer research
- Microbiome and virome analysis
- Spatial transcriptomics
- Survival analysis, Bayesian statistics and reproducible research

## Current affiliation

- CNIO: Spanish National Cancer Research Center
- CIBERONC: Centro de Investigacion Biomedica en Red Cancer

## Services and collaboration areas

- Bioinformatics and multi-omics analysis
- Biostatistics, survival analysis and Bayesian modelling
- AI/ML methods for biomedical datasets
- Microbiome, virome and spatial transcriptomics analysis
- Reproducible reports, code and manuscript-ready outputs
